review.images: Reviewed the official project gallery and Aldar brochure hosted by Property Finder. Preserved original embedded image bytes from physical brochure pages 5, 6, 26, 27 and 31, and used project-specific Aldar launch assets for outdoor amenities. Gallery identifies the two precinct aerials separately. Source brochure matched its previously reviewed SHA-256.
review.location: Aldar’s English connections diagram and brochure physical page 3 place the project at the E75 corridor and give five matching travel estimates. Separate phase entrance coordinates are unverified. Name-based directions preserve precinct uncertainty.
review.floorPlans: Visually reviewed all seven complete physical pages of the PDF compiled and hosted by Golden Dome. The three matching Property Finder drawings support ownership and layout checks. Its 3 BR corner image is labelled Type 1 in the portal with 1,530 sq ft, while other sources associate the corner with the larger size. Displayed the published 1,530–1,571 sq ft category range across three-bedroom templates without assigning individual areas. Source for category sizes: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/new-projects/aldar-properties-pjsc/al-ghadeer-parks

unavailable: Signed variant-specific home area, measurement basis, pool inclusion and distinct phase entrance coordinates.
